from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from threading import Condition, Event
import time
from cachetools import cached

for info in (False, True):
    cond = Condition()
    entered, release = Event(), Event()
    calls = []
    @cached({}, condition=cond, info=info)
    def wrapped(key):
        calls.append(key)
        entered.set()
        assert release.wait(timeout=3)
        return key
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
        first = pool.submit(wrapped, 1)
        assert entered.wait(timeout=3)
        second = pool.submit(wrapped, 1)
        time.sleep(.02)
        # Unrelated notifications must not start duplicate work.
        with cond:
            cond.notify_all()
        time.sleep(.02)
        assert calls == [1]
        wrapped.cache_clear()
        third = pool.submit(wrapped, 1)
        time.sleep(.02)
        assert calls == [1]
        release.set()
        assert [f.result(timeout=3) for f in (first, second, third)] == [1, 1, 1]
    assert calls == [1]
print('Spurious notification and cache_clear-during-computation checks passed.')
